1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, wherein said light emitting diodes and said fins are configured to provide enhanced thermal management.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open.

5. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body, with at least one fin positioned to improve thermal transfer between the diodes and the environment.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes and configured to facilitate airflow across said diodes.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current, further including thermal management features to maintain optimal performance of said light emitting diodes.
